results.title: Full Stack Developer (Java / Spring Boot & Angular) – Full Remote
results.description:
**Chi siamo**

Entra in AGAP2 Italia: lavorerai in un contesto internazionale e collaborativo, con progetti in diversi settori e opportunità di contribuire a iniziative ingegneristiche e IT sfidanti. Parte del Gruppo MoOngy, AGAP2 è presente sul mercato europeo in 14 paesi con servizi di consulenza ingegneristica e IT. Dal 2018, agap2 Italia opera sul territorio nazionale nei seguenti settori: Automotive, Aerospace, Industrial Automation, Energy, Oil & Gas, Betting & Gaming, Fashion & Luxury, Finance, Healthcare.

**Il Ruolo**

Per un importante progetto evolutivo in ambito Pubblica Amministrazione focalizzato sullo sviluppo di piattaforme gestionali, cerchiamo uno Sviluppatore Full Stack (livello Middle / Senior). La risorsa entrerà a far parte di un team strutturato contribuendo attivamente allo sviluppo sia lato backend che frontend.

**Cosa farai**

- Progettare, sviluppare e manutenere funzionalità end-to-end su applicativi gestionali complessi per il settore della Pubblica Amministrazione.
- Sviluppare servizi backend scalabili e API RESTful utilizzando Java e il framework Spring Boot.
- Realizzare e ottimizzare interfacce utente moderne, responsive e performanti tramite framework Angular.
- Garantire la qualità del codice, l'affidabilità delle integrazioni e il rispetto delle best practice di sviluppo software.
- Collaborare quotidianamente in modalità agile con il team tecnico e gli stakeholder di progetto.

**Requisiti richiesti**

- **Esperienza:** Seniority di livello Middle o Senior nello sviluppo Full Stack su architetture web enterprise.
- **Competenze Backend:** Solida padronanza di **Java** e del framework **Spring Boot**.
- **Competenze Frontend:** Comprovata esperienza nello sviluppo con **Angular** (TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3).
- **Sede di lavoro:** Full Remote (100% da remoto su territorio italiano).

**Offerta e Inquadramento**

*La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 30.000 EUR e 45.000 EUR. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla nostra società. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna. Oltre all'assunzione diretta, per questa posizione valutiamo positivamente anche collaborazioni in regime di libera professione (Partita IVA), con tariffa economica da concordare in base alla reale seniority del profilo.*

results.title: Full Stack Engineer - Tiger
results.description:
Ledgebrook is an AI-native specialty insurance platform. When a business needs coverage that is custom and complex, its broker comes to us, and our underwriters give them an answer, often in hours rather than weeks.

We built our technology from scratch, with AI in it from the first line of code. The technology helps price the risk; the underwriter uses their judgment to decide. There are always two hands on the wheel.

We are insurance industry insiders, and we eat our own cooking: Ledgebrook writes the policy and shares the risk through our own carrier, Ledgebrook Specialty, rated A- (Excellent) by AM Best. We work exclusively through wholesale brokers.

Our vision: to make the wheels of insurance spin faster.

At Ledgebrook, everything we do is driven by our culture: Care, Strive, Thrive Together. To succeed in modernizing the industry, we must first succeed in changing the way we do business. Talent density is our north star—fewer, better people working together as one. To that end we’ve replaced all individual incentives with generous equity packages—we play as a team, we win as a team. Everyone benefits handsomely from Ledgebrook’s success.

### About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Full Stack Software Engineer to help us solve the complex, technical challenges of a changing insurance landscape. The ideal candidate loves to build, communicates well with team members , and is motivated by a less bureaucracy. This person will be a key member of our engineering team, with direct ownership of many parts of the stack.

**What you’ll do**

- Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to develop new features and enhance existing applications.
- Design and implement frontend and backend components using JavaScript (Node.js) and Python.
- Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party services as needed.
- Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards.
- Implement automated tests and ensure high code quality through code reviews and continuous integration.
- Optimize application performance and scalability to handle growing user demands.
- Dive into using and building LLMs (Large Language Models) to enhance our underwriters' productivity.
- Debug production issues using the latest tooling.
- Help set the direction of the small but growing engineering team.

### About you

Here at Ledgebrook we are passionate about creating a team that is on a continuous learning journey and that shares our excitement about building a company from the ground up. Some of the characteristics we hold dear are:

- A passion to deliver a world-class customer service experience to both internal and external customers
- Intellectual curiosity and a desire to innovate processes/procedures versus being satisfied with the status quo
- A desire to continue learning whatever your career stage
- Agile prioritization skills coupled with a keen sense of urgency that seeks to balance getting it right versus getting it done right now
- A strong drive and desire to win together as a high-performing team
- A moral compass to “do the right thing, period”, we have zero tolerance for toxic behaviors.

### Requirements

**Must haves**

- 3+ years of experience with the full stack development
- Ability to facilitate and gather business requirements and come up with scalable engineering solutions
- Strong ability to design data models based on business domain use cases
- Proven ability to write code for the future, with a strong focus on maintainability and testability
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools using Github Actions, AWS Code Pipelines, Jenkins, or other
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, organizational and time management skills
- Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously per the objectives/goals of the organization and execute to deadlines

**Nice to haves**

- Prior startup experience
- Experience with Python, JavaScript
- Experience solving insurance industry / domain related challenges
- Experience in web technologies and frameworks (JS/TS, HTML, CSS/SCSS, Angular, React, Bootstrap, Node.js)
- Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

### Benefits

- Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture
- Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave
- Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options
- Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage
- A high degree of ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to help build and shape a growing company
- The chance to make a meaningful impact while working alongside an ambitious, high-performing team
- Exposure to the challenges and opportunities of a fast-growing startup environment

### Compensation

- Base Salary Range $100,000-150,000 USD This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including experience, qualifications, geographic location and other relevant factors.
- Employees in this position are eligible to participate in Ledgebrook’s equity incentive program.

**For Candidates Applying From The U.S.:**

***Please note: This position is open only to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. We are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.***

**For Candidates Applying From Poland:**

***Please note: This position is open only to candidates who are authorized to work in Poland without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. We are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.***

**For Candidates Applying From Canada:**

***Please note: This position is open only to candidates who are authorized to work in Canada without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. We are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.***

AI is used as a support tool, and hiring decisions are made by human recruiters. By submitting your information, you acknowledge that the company may use AI tools as part of our evaluation. If you need a reasonable accommodation or alternative review process because of a disability or other legally protected basis, contact hiring@ledgebrook.com. Requesting an accommodation will not negatively affect your application.***

results.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (fintech)
results.description:
About the Role

Our client is a cutting-edge Fin Tech company that operates entirely remotely, connecting talent from across South Africa. We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Full Stack Software Engineer to join our distributed development team. This is a fully remote position, allowing you to work from anywhere in the country. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications and services that power our innovative financial solutions. This role requires a strong command of both front-end and back-end technologies, a passion for clean code, and a collaborative spirit. You'll work in an agile environment, contributing to all phases of the software development lifecycle. We pride ourselves on our remote-first culture, fostering collaboration and innovation through digital tools and processes. This is an exceptional opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking company without geographical constraints, working from your preferred location, ideally near Bloemfontein or within the Free State province, though not mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using modern technologies.
- Write clean, efficient, well-documented, and testable code for both front-end and back-end systems.
- Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define and implement new features.
- Develop and manage APIs and microservices.
- Implement and manage database solutions (SQL and No SQL).
- Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems.
- Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making.
- Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
- Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry best practices.

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 3+ years of professional experience in full-stack development.
- Proficiency in front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, Java Script, and frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js.
- Strong experience with back-end languages such as Python (Django/Flask), Node.js, Java, or similar.
- Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgre SQL, My SQL) and No SQL databases (e.g., Mongo DB, Redis).
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Understanding of software development best practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD, and automated testing.
- Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially in a remote team environment.
- Experience working in a remote-first setting is a significant advantage.

Benefits

- This is a fully remote role offering significant flexibility.
- Our client provides a competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
- Employees receive a comprehensive remote work stipend to enhance their home office setup.
- Health insurance benefits are provided, often through a national provider accessible anywhere in South Africa.
- Opportunities for professional growth include access to online courses, virtual workshops, and conference attendance.
- The company fosters a strong remote culture with regular virtual team-building activities and open communication channels.
- Generous annual leave and flexible working hours are standard.
- This role allows you to contribute to innovative Fin Tech solutions from the comfort of your home, regardless of your specific location in Free State.

results.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
results.description:
**Ready to accelerate your career?**

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

At Cardata, we help businesses simplify vehicle reimbursement. Join a team building software that makes work easier for companies and their drivers.

We’re searching for a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and evolve our Portal. It’s the platform our customers use to manage reimbursements, payments, and insurance verification for their drivers. Our roadmap includes AI features, enterprise-scale workflows, and complex integrations that support some of our most strategic customer experiences.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you’ll work with Product, Design, QA, and subject-matter experts to turn customer problems into technical designs and build features end to end, from the data model and API to the screens customers use.

This is a hands-on role with ownership of delivery and production health. You’ll work within established platform patterns, partner with senior engineers on technical designs, and use AI coding agents every day to deliver faster while maintaining a high standard of quality.

## **What You’ll Do**

- Own features from technical design through launch and ongoing production health, including data models, APIs, background jobs, and customer-facing interfaces.
- Work with Product and Design to understand the customer problem, shape solutions, and agree on scope and success criteria before development begins. Demo your work and answer questions before release.
- Break complex work into small, working increments, deliver against agreed dates, and raise risks as soon as you see them.
- Build fast, intuitive interfaces in React and Next.js that stay responsive at enterprise scale, pass automated accessibility checks, and meet Design’s expectations before release.
- Own technical decisions for your features, including component structure, state management, data fetching, and API design, within existing codebase patterns. Work with senior engineers on designs and document departures from established patterns through architecture decision records.
- Build with shared design-system components and reusable patterns, leaving the code you touch cleaner and easier for other engineers to build on.
- Agree on test plans with the QA Architect before development. Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, applying the same review standards to AI-generated code as to any other code.
- Use AI coding agents to accelerate prototyping, development, debugging, refactoring, and testing, with careful review of their output.
- Partner with the Integrations pod where your features connect with theirs, and with the Mobile team on capabilities that span the app and Portal, including shared APIs.
- Protect payment details and drivers’ personal information through secure access, careful data handling, and reliable separation of customer data.
- Help teammates and new hires through thoughtful code reviews, pairing, onboarding, and contributions to architecture discussions and engineering practices.

In your first 30 days, you’ll learn the Portal’s architecture and patterns and ship changes to production. Within three months, you’ll have delivered your first feature end to end by its agreed deadline, with success criteria agreed up front and a demo accepted by Product. You’ll be picking up new features without close guidance. Within six months, several features you’ve built will be live and meeting their quality goals, you’ll be managing more than one project at a time reliably, and teammates will come to you for help in the areas you know well.

## **What You Bring**

- 4+ years building modern web applications, including experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database. Your track record matters more than your title.
- Daily experience using AI coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code. You work from clear specifications, provide useful context, and know when to verify an agent’s output. You can show how AI has made your work faster and better.
- Experience owning features across the full stack, from database schemas and backend services to APIs, background jobs, and user interfaces. You can explain the changes you made and the trade-offs across those layers.
- Experience building fast, intuitive interfaces in React and Next.js, with sound component architecture, state management, and data-fetching practices.
- Strong engineering fundamentals, including clean, maintainable code, unit and integration testing, end-to-end testing, and CI/CD. You consider performance and scalability as you build.
- Ownership of timelines and outcomes, with the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear, shippable increments.
- The ability to work directly with Product, Design, and subject-matter experts to shape solutions and explain technical decisions clearly.
- An understanding of how to protect personal and financial data, including role-based access, encryption at rest, keeping secrets out of logs, and preventing data from crossing customer boundaries.
- A collaborative approach to code reviews, pairing, and onboarding. You share what you know and help others improve.
- Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, or SNS; internal tools, platforms, or design systems; analytics tools such as Snowflake or ThoughtSpot; or a high-growth SaaS environment is a plus.

Our current stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, Next.js, React, PostgreSQL with Prisma, BullMQ, Redis, Vitest, Playwright, GitHub Actions, Datadog, and Flagsmith feature flags.

**Compensation**

In line with Ontario’s Pay Transparency legislation, the salary range for this role is $130,000 – $150,000 CAD annually, based on experience, skills, and alignment with the role requirements. This is a vacant position, and we are hiring with intention and seeking someone who will bring new perspective, contribute meaningfully to the team, and grow with the organization.

**Why you’ll love working at Cardata:**

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

What we offer in return for you bringing your best:

Our client is a remote product studio that builds MVPs and custom software for startups and companies past the idea stage. Clients hire them for a fixed-scope MVP or for a product team billed by the two-week sprint, and the whole team uses AI coding tools every day.

### Your Role

You’ll join the team building workflow software for one of the studio’s clients: a live product that needs new workflow features while the existing ones keep running. The client's own engineers commit to the same repo, so every new table, permission and workflow goes in next to code someone else is changing. The weight is on the server side, from the SQL database on Azure up through the API, and you also build the React and TypeScript screens that sit on top.

AI coding tools draft most of the specs, tests and migrations. You direct them, read every diff line by line, and answer for what merges. If you'd rather write most of the code by hand, this probably isn't the right seat.

You report to the studio's leadership and work day to day with the lead developer and the product manager, who sets the acceptance criteria for each sprint. Success means delivering four to five features per two-week sprint, each verified before merge, and owning one area end to end (such as the task engine or the legacy migration) without breaking a live feature.

### You Bring:

- 4+ years building full-stack web applications and releasing them to production
- Experience working in a codebase you didn't write, learning its conventions before changing it
- Hands-on work on workflow software where different user roles see different data, with approvals, task queues or state machines and an audit log or versioned history
- React, TypeScript and SQL on Azure, including schema design and migrations
- Daily use of Cursor, Claude Code or a similar AI coding tool on production work, with tests and CI behind it
- Clear written and spoken English
- Experience delivering in fixed-scope sprints with branches, code review and feature flags

### Bonus Points:

- Work in a regulated setting such as finance, health or insurance
- A migration from a legacy system, with reconciliation and duplicate review
- Time as an outside vendor committing to a client's repo
- Project rules, custom prompts or agent setups for AI coding tools that your team adopted
- Spanish, since the platform is bilingual

### What's Offered:

- Fully remote contractor role from LATAM, full time at about 40 hours a week
- Core hours in US time zones, so your day overlaps with the lead developer and the product manager
- An area of the product to own end to end, with your schema designs reviewed by the lead developer and the client's engineers
- A team where AI-first delivery is already the daily routine, with tests, CI and feature flags as part of the normal process

- **Leadership Screening:** A short call, possibly with an async part first
- **Product and Developer Conversation:** How you take features from acceptance criteria to merge

results.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (2+ years experience: United States)
results.description:
### This is a remote position.

Wanderlog is hiring a full-time engineer to help build and scale our web and mobile travel planning products. This is a permanent, full-time role reporting to the co-founders at Wanderlog.

**Role details**

- **Employment type:** Full-time
- **Location:** Remote — United States
- **Reports to:** Co-founders
- **Salary range:** $110,000-$170,000 USD, depending on experience

**About Wanderlog**

Wanderlog helps make leisure travel easier. We believe that travel makes the world better, and are building tools that lower the bar to it.

Our core product, built starting in 2019, is a travel planning app, but we’re also helping travelers book hotels (without hidden fees), providing them with information through pages such as best attractions and restaurants, and more.

We’re a small, engineering- and product-driven team building tools used by travelers worldwide.

Wanderlog was founded by twin brothers Peter Xu and Harry Yu, who previously built successful travel products before starting Wanderlog.

**What you'll do**

As an engineer, you’ll be responsible for owning portions of the product. You’ll be expected to:

- Build new features on our website and mobile app. (Our stack is Javascript (Typescript): modern React on the web, React Native on mobile, and Node.js/Express on the server.)
- Design and decide what to build based on what would help travelers and drive growth. You won’t be handed a spec; you’ll be coming up with it!
- Build data pipelines to crawl, process, and synthesize data from various sources around the web.
- Write tests and build out engineering infrastructure. Our code is fully typed (Typescript) and tested.
- Debug and fix bugs and scale the infrastructure as it grows.
- Review code written by other engineers.
- Be fast and nimble: figure out the best way to build new features at the lowest cost in time and future technical debt.

**What you might work on**

- New, user-friendly hotel booking interfaces that make finding a place to stay easier.
- AI-powered tools that read articles and watch videos for you and summarize the places they mention.
- Improvements to our React Native mobile app so that it runs faster on slower Android phones.
- A Chrome extension to let travelers quickly compare possible places to visit, airfares, and hotels.
- Better invite and collaboration tools to encourage people to use Wanderlog to get more friends to join them.
- A better profile page that lets travelers on Wanderlog show off where they’ve been, see how many people they’ve helped, and follow other friends and their trips.

**What it's like to work here**

We’re an engineering- and product-heavy team. A typical week involves talking to users, prioritizing tasks, designing in Figma, and continuously building and shipping improvements.

Our values include putting travelers first, owning the product end-to-end, treating teammates with respect, and moving fast by being thoughtful about what we build.

We believe work should fit into your life. We also hold twice-annual travel off sites to collaborate more closely and enjoy visiting new places together.

**Hiring process**

- Two short asynchronous programming challenges, including an automated coding assessment
- A live coding interview with one of the founders
- A half-day final-round virtual onsite conducted via video call

### Requirements

- Have at least 2 years of experience doing full-stack, product development work. We have a wide salary range, as we do want to accept a range of candidate experiences properly.
- Are a Javascript developer comfortable with React and/or React Native.
- Are a product person: you’ve built products end-to-end before, and really care about the people who use them.
- Are comfortable with picking up various technologies for the task at hand. We quickly evaluate libraries and tools that could help our product, and variously use Redis, Elasticsearch, and Python as needed too.
- Are entrepreneurial: excited about joining a small, high-growth team and talking to users, doing product and design, and wearing a variety of hats.
- Love travel and believe in it as a positive force personally and for the world.

### Benefits

- Medical
- Vision
- Dental
- FSA or HSA plans
- Paid sick leave

- Design and decide what to build based on what would help travelers and drive growth. You won’t be handed a spec; you’ll be coming up with it!
- Build data pipelines to crawl, process, and synthesize data from various sources around the web.
- Write tests and build out engineering infrastructure. Our code is fully typed (Typescript) and tested.
- Debug and fix bugs and scale the infrastructure as it grows.
- Review code written by other engineers.
- Be fast and nimble: figure out the best way to build new features at the lowest cost in time and future technical debt.

**What you might work on**

- New, user-friendly hotel booking interfaces that make finding a place to stay easier.
- AI-powered tools that read articles and watch videos for you and summarize the places they mention.
- Improvements to our React Native mobile app so that it runs faster on slower Android phones.
- A Chrome extension to let travelers quickly compare possible places to visit, airfares, and hotels.
- Better invite and collaboration tools to encourage people to use Wanderlog to get more friends to join them.
- A better profile page that lets travelers on Wanderlog show off where they’ve been, see how many people they’ve helped, and follow other friends and their trips.

**What it's like to work here**

We’re an engineering- and product-heavy team. A typical week involves talking to users, prioritizing tasks, designing in Figma, and continuously building and shipping improvements.

Our values include putting travelers first, owning the product end-to-end, treating teammates with respect, and moving fast by being thoughtful about what we build.

We believe work should fit into your life. We also hold twice-annual travel off sites to collaborate more closely and enjoy visiting new places together.

**Hiring process**

- Two short asynchronous programming challenges, including an automated coding assessment
- A live coding interview with one of the founders
- A half-day final-round virtual onsite conducted via video call

### Requirements

- Have at least 2 years of experience doing full-stack, product development work. We have a wide salary range, as we do want to accept a range of candidate experiences properly.
- Are a Javascript developer comfortable with React and/or React Native.
- Are a product person: you’ve built products end-to-end before, and really care about the people who use them.
- Are comfortable with picking up various technologies for the task at hand. We quickly evaluate libraries and tools that could help our product, and variously use Redis, Elasticsearch, and Python as needed too.
- Are entrepreneurial: excited about joining a small, high-growth team and talking to users, doing product and design, and wearing a variety of hats.
- Love travel and believe in it as a positive force personally and for the world.

### Benefits

- Medical
- Vision
- Dental
- FSA or HSA plans
- Paid sick leave
